Central.reason: Central Line: Severe delays due to an earlier fire alert at Shepherd's Bush. Tickets are being accepted on London Buses, Liberty line, Elizabeth line, Great Western Railway, Chiltern Railways and Greater Anglia.

District.reason: District Line: Minor delays between Richmond and Turnham Green due to hot weather mitigation measures. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Elizabeth line.reason: A reduced service operates between Paddington and Heathrow Terminal 4 & 5 due to heat mitigation measures and earlier signal system failure.

Jubilee.reason: Jubilee Line: Minor delays due to train cancellations.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: Minor delays between Rickmansworth and Amersham / Chesham due to an earlier points failure at Chalfont & Latimer. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Mildmay.reason: Mildmay Line: Severe delays due to an earlier signal failure at Hackney Central. London Underground are accepting tickets via any reasonable route.
